info: Gates census: every clause of the browser gate layers 1-3 (structural, measurement, perceptual, anatomy) as the title of the test that enforces it.

gates.test.js asserts that each listed title is a test() in its spec, and that each spec declares exactly as many tests as it has rows here, so a clause cannot stay unbuilt and a test cannot go unlisted.
A dynamic title is listed by the literal part the spec concatenates. A row is added by the reasoning tier when a clause is added to the gate definition.

gates.clause: zero console and page errors
gates.title: the showcase renders every component with zero errors

gates.clause: no overlapping siblings, no overflow
gates.title: every cell has rendered content within its bounds

gates.clause: text stays inside the painted box behind it
gates.title: no text overflows the box that paints behind it

gates.clause: no clipped text, no unit strings
gates.title: no clipped text and no unit string in an inline style

gates.clause: target >= 44
gates.title: interactive targets are at least 44 points

gates.clause: contrast >= 4.5 for text (3.0 large; disabled exempt; listed exceptions reproduce)
gates.title: every drawn text run meets the contrast minimum against its backdrop

gates.clause: every enabled variant renders distinguishably from its disabled state
gates.title: every enabled control state paints differently from every disabled state of its component

gates.clause: accessibility tree identical across the three templates
gates.title: the accessibility tree is identical under every template

gates.clause: every built row is classified
gates.title: every built row is classified and the showcase exposes it

gates.clause: parts match the rendered primary reference
gates.title: : parts match the rendered upstream

gates.clause: every row with a second twin carries a second block
gates.title: every row with a second twin carries a second reference block

gates.clause: every primary part measured against the second reference or omitted with a reason
gates.title: every primary part is measured against the second reference or omitted with a reason

gates.clause: parts match the rendered second reference; an omitted part still draws nothing there
gates.title: : parts match the second reference

gates.clause: every sample state, and every enabled state while hovered, keyboard focused and pressed, matches each reference under the light and the dark scheme: geometry, type, colors at the opacity they are painted at, sampled paint, and the ring and shadow pixels at the anchor part; within the row's diff_budget, a masked omission left out of the pixels and never covering the anchor part; no expected gap
gates.title: : matches the reference in every state

gates.clause: the pixel pipeline discriminates
gates.title: the pixel pipeline discriminates: self is 0, blank is not

gates.clause: a measurement cell paints no chrome
gates.title: a measurement cell paints no chrome of its own

gates.clause: mismatch within the row's diff_budget
gates.title: : mismatch within diff_budget

gates.clause: floating label notch pixel-sampled
gates.title: the raised label opens a notch in the outline: surface color under the label, border color beside it

gates.clause: ripple state layer changes after press
gates.title: a held press paints the state layer over a button and releasing it clears it

gates.clause: a declared additional field target executes hover, focus and pressed on both pages
gates.title: the fidelity driver exercises every declared field-action phase

gates.clause: shadow-root main targets cannot silently skip their declared interactions
gates.title: the fidelity driver exercises declared shadow-target phases

gates.clause: part visibility requires positive area and nonzero effective opacity while preserving real hairlines; explicitly compared box padding is read
gates.title: the part reader rejects zero-area and transparent-ancestor seats but keeps hairlines

gates.clause: numeric keyboard focus collapses browser-selected text without changing the value, matching the text-field focus fixture
gates.title: keyboard focus collapses numeric selection without changing its value

gates.clause: intrinsic compact selections fit their complete selected labels after fonts load in every template and scheme
gates.title: intrinsically sized selections retain complete labels after fonts load

gates.clause: slider fill coverage and disabled group opacity agree with source pixels at minimum, quarter, half and maximum in both schemes and both references
gates.title: : fill coverage and disabled overlap match the actual source pixels

gates.clause: real web slider keyboard and responder gestures update the same numeric value while an invalid numeric draft does not move the thumb
gates.title: Slider live web responders: keyboard, track press, drag and invalid numeric draft

gates.clause: declared translation-only pseudo transforms contribute to measured painted bounds
gates.title: the part reader applies declared pseudo translations before comparing slider ticks

gates.clause: a painted pointer anchor covered by a native input is exercised at its coordinates, and slider cleanup releases before moving
gates.title: the slider point driver reaches a covered input and releases before moving away

gates.clause: slider enabled and disabled signatures measure the real face rather than its transparent semantic press target
gates.title: structural paint reads a slider face rather than its transparent press target

gates.clause: an explicitly scaled radius is measured in the same transformed coordinates as its bounding box
gates.title: the part reader compares a uniformly scaled radius in painted coordinates
